title: D-Skill: Distilling Teacher Knowledge through Agent Skills
abstract: arXiv:2610.28914v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Frontier language-model agents excel at complex tasks, but high inference costs make transferring their capabilities to smaller models essential. Traditional knowledge distillation achieves this through parameter updates, requiring access to the student's weights and additional training compute while encoding the transferred knowledge implicitly in the parameters. We introduce D-Skill, a framework that treats the teacher as a black box and distills its behavioral advantage into an interpretable natural-language skill by analyzing paired rollouts and identifying behavioral divergences and agreements. The resulting lessons are consolidated offline, with any compatible skill-update backend, into a skill document that is provided to the student at inference time. D-Skill constructs the skill entirely offline from fixed trajectories, without labels, further environment interaction, or weight updates after rollout collection. Across Spreadshee

translated_title: D-Skill：通过智能体技能蒸馏教师知识
translated_abstract: 前沿语言模型智能体在复杂任务上表现出色，但其高昂的推理成本使得将它们的能力迁移到更小的模型变得至关重要。传统知识蒸馏通过参数更新来实现这一目标，这需要访问学生模型的权重并消耗额外的训练计算资源，同时将迁移的知识隐式地编码在参数中。我们提出了D-Skill，一个将教师模型视为黑盒的框架，它通过分析成对的轨迹、识别行为上的差异与一致性，将教师模型的行为优势蒸馏为可解释的自然语言技能。所得的经验教训在离线状态下，借助任何兼容的技能更新后端，整合为一份技能文档，并在推理时提供给学生模型。D-Skill完全基于固定的轨迹离线构建技能，无需标签、无需进一步的环境交互、也无需在轨迹收集后进行权重更新。在电子表格……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: D-Skill提出了一种将教师智能体视为黑盒的离线知识蒸馏框架，通过分析成对轨迹提炼出可解释的自然语言技能文档并在推理时提供给小模型，全程无需标签、环境交互或权重更新。
en_tdlr: D-Skill is an offline distillation framework that treats the teacher agent as a black box and distills its behavioral advantages into an interpretable natural-language skill document by analyzing paired rollouts, requiring no labels, further environment interaction, or weight updates.
